phase1.name: The SolarWinds Operators
phase1.origin: Russian state-sponsored intelligence agency (SVR) operating in cyberspace since the late 2000s
phase1.background: Highly sophisticated APT group with military-grade capabilities, focused on espionage and long-term network access. Known for sophisticated supply chain attacks and methodical operational security.
phase1.coreMotivation: Gain sustained access to U.S. government networks and critical infrastructure without detection, enabling long-term intelligence gathering on national security matters

phase2.roleAndRank: State-Sponsored APT Team Leader / SVR Cyber Operations Division

relationships.name: SolarWinds Development Team
relationships.description: Unwitting collaboration partners in supply chain compromise

relationships.name: FireEye Security Researchers
relationships.description: First major discoverers of the operation

storyArc.act1: 2019-2020: Identified SolarWinds Orion as high-value supply chain target with access to thousands of government and private sector networks
storyArc.act2: March-December 2020: Successfully injected malicious code (SUNBURST) into SolarWinds update pipeline, compromised 18,000+ customers including multiple U.S. government agencies
storyArc.act3: December 2020 onwards: FireEye discovered the breach, U.S. government response, attribution to SVR confirmed, international sanctions imposed, operation exposed but legacy compromises persist
